summary: Backend-only testing for 'Versetto del Giorno' (Verse of the Day). All 16 pytest cases PASSED (100%). Verified /api/verse/today (deterministic same-day), /api/verse/{id} (200 + 404), admin listing with 124 seeded verses, case-insensitive search by reference and text substring, admin CRUD (create 201, patch, patch-unknown-404, delete), inactive verses excluded from today's rotation (with restore), and auth guard 401 on list/create/patch/delete without token. Database restored: 124 verses, 0 TEST_ leftovers, 0 inactive after cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~3856 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting routers into modules (verses, donations, meditations, etc.). Not a blocker for this feature.

GET /api/admin/verses with search does not escape user input passed to $regex; a malicious search string with regex metacharacters could cause ReDoS on large collections. Consider re.escape() on the search term before building the $regex query.

DELETE /api/admin/verses/{vid} always returns {ok:true} even if the id doesn't exist (no 404 when delete_count==0). Non-blocking; requirements only required PATCH-unknown to return 404, but for parity consider adding 404 on delete miss.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed verses created and fully deleted at teardown; all seeded verses reactivated. Final DB state: 124 verses, 0 inactive, 0 TEST_ leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verse-of-the-day endpoints stable. Admin login via POST /api/auth/login with pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it/AdminTestPwd1! returns a session_token used as Bearer. Seed count = 124 (VERSES_SEED). Rotation: date.toordinal() % count over active verses sorted by (order, created_at).
